critique — gap: Momentum never costs anything: a full-stick reversal at 8.3 m/s is a constant-speed 12.8 m carve (min speed 8.3, no brake), a turn can exceed the speed cap (+18% at walk), and 24 m/s2 of air accel lets a sprint jump fully reverse mid-air (vz -8.3 -> +8.29). The module docstring's 'slam the stick backwards and the character brakes into a pivot' is unreachable code. Separately a BLOCKER: Locomotion._spawn calls groundAt(x,400,z) against groundAt(x,z,fromY) - proven live, with a real collider mounted the player spawns at (0,0.91,0) 39 m under a y=40 terrain and falls forever.
